summary.text: Kate Donaghue is a Democratic state representative from the 19th Worcester District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her priorities include health care, with a focus on substance use disorder and family caregivers, climate change and public education.

paragraphs.text: Kate Donaghue graduated from Notre Dame Academy, and Ballotpedia lists a master's degree in medical technology from Northeastern University in 1983 and a master's degree in computer science from Worcester Polytechnic Institute in 1988.

She is vice chair of the House Committee on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability and also serves on the Joint Committees on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities, Community Development and Small Businesses, and Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery.
In the survey she said she wants to improve the health care system, support universal pre-kindergarten and public schools, and see Massachusetts lead on climate while federal action lags.
